name: holdout4
seeds: Hi! I'm Luciana Ferreira Campos, born 14/03/1984. I grew up in Juiz de Fora and moved to Belo Horizonte in 2008 — been here ever since.
My mum is Marta Ferreira, she still lives in Juiz de Fora. My dad, Antônio Campos, passed away on 8 November 2019.
I was married to Ricardo Almeida from 2008 until we divorced in 2017. We have two kids together: Beatriz (everyone calls her Bia), born 5 July 2010, and Davi, born 19/12/2013.
Fernando Siqueira and I got married on 22/04/2021 at Paróquia São José. He works as an anaesthetist at Hospital Santa Clara.
Big news: my brother Gustavo and his wife Patrícia had a baby girl, Helena, on 3 Feb 2026 — and they asked me to be her godmother!
Larissa is my half-sister, from Dad's second marriage. She lives in Campinas and is getting married on 14/11/2026. I plan to give her R$ 5.000 towards the wedding.
Meu primo Rafael Ferreira acabou de se mudar para Lisboa com a esposa, a Inês. Quando é mesmo o aniversário dele?
Fernando's mother, Dona Lúcia Siqueira, was born on 2 March 1956. She's the one who finally taught me to make pão de queijo properly.

Seu Joaquim Moreira, our neighbour on the 3rd floor, waters the plants whenever we travel. And Dona Rosa Pereira, who was my ama de leite (wet nurse) when I was a baby, still phones me every birthday.

seeds.text: 12/08/2025. Signed the deed today. Gustavo and I sold Dad's apartment on Rua Halfeld in Juiz de Fora — the one we inherited half each in 2020 — to Cristina Lopes for R$ 340.000. We decided to split it straight down the middle, so my half, R$ 170.000, went into the house fund. Strange feeling, closing that door.

seeds: Career-wise: I was at Banco Horizonte for twelve years, starting in 2009 as a trainee analyst, and left in 2021 as credit manager.

Since May 2022 I've been financial controller at Grupo Ipê Logística. My boss is Marcos Tavares, the CFO, and I work closely with Aline Barbosa in treasury. Pay is R$ 18.500 a month. Our biggest client is Laticínios Boa Vista — their contract renewal is due 15/11/2026 and I'm leading the negotiation.

In September 2023 Juliana Rocha and I founded Campos & Rocha Consultoria — finance for small businesses, mostly on weekends. I hold 60% and she holds 40%, and I'm the sócia-administradora (managing partner). Juliana's been my best friend since UFMG, where we both did Accounting, 2002 to 2006.

The consultoria's first client was Padaria Pão de Minas, they pay us R$ 4.800 a month. Wesley Pinto does our bookkeeping as a contractor; paid him R$ 1.200 in August 2026. We plan to take on two more clients next year.
I sing in the choir at Paróquia São José. I'm also in the caixinha at work with nine colleagues — everyone puts in R$ 1.000 a month, and my turn to take the pot (R$ 10.000) came in March 2026.

WE BOUGHT THE LOT! Lagoa Santa, 10/02/2024, R$ 285.000, from Sr. Paulo Mendes. It's lot 14, block C in Condomínio Recanto das Garças, matrícula nº 48.213 at the registry. Fernando and I own it together.
Small correction about the Lagoa Santa lot: after Paulo's discount we actually paid R$ 278.000, not 285.

seeds.text:
From: Camila Duarte (architect)
To: Luciana, Fernando
Subject: Casa Lagoa Santa - final plan and budget

Hi Luciana and Fernando,

Attached is the final plan for the Lagoa Santa house (3 bedrooms, 210 m²). As agreed, my fee as architect is R$ 18.000 in two instalments; I received the first R$ 9.000 on 20/03/2024, thank you. Edson Lima's quote for the full build came in at R$ 420.000, which sits inside your R$ 450.000 budget.

Best,
Camila Duarte

seeds: Construction on the Lagoa Santa house officially started on 15 August 2024! Edson Lima is our mestre de obras. Paid him the first R$ 35.000 that day.
Paid Camila the second half of her fee, R$ 9.000, on 05/09/2024. Foundation was finished by the end of September 2024.
Mum sent R$ 20.000 towards the house, she insisted. Fernando put in R$ 150.000 from his savings. I paid Edson R$ 40.000 on 10 Dec 2024, and the laje (concrete slab) was poured in March 2025.
Edson quit on us in May 2025 — says he got a bigger job in Sete Lagoas. Work on the house is paused. Ugh. We decided not to take him to court, it's not worth it.
Found a new builder: Sandro Ribeiro of Ribeiro Construções. His quote to finish the house is R$ 310.000. Work restarted 16/06/2025 and I paid him R$ 60.000 on 30 June.

seeds.text:
RECIBO

Recebi de Luciana Ferreira Campos a quantia de R$ 55.000,00 (cinquenta e cinco mil reais), referente à 2ª etapa da obra da Casa Lagoa Santa (estrutura do telhado).

Belo Horizonte, 03/11/2025.

Sandro Ribeiro
Ribeiro Construções

seeds: The roof on the Lagoa Santa house was finished in February 2026. Jorge Nunes is doing the electrics for R$ 22.000; paid him R$ 11.000 upfront on 12/03/2026. Fernando and I decided to put in solar panels instead of the pool.

Paid Sandro another R$ 70.000 on 5 August 2026. He says the house will be ready by 30/11/2026, and we plan to move to Lagoa Santa in January 2027. Fernando and I decided Mum will come and live with us there.

Car stuff: we bought the Fiat Toro (plate RTA-4B27) in October 2022 for R$ 128.500. It's insured with Seguradora Atlântica, policy 77-0045123, next renewal 15/03/2027. And we sold the old Honda Fit, plate HFX-2190, to Seu Joaquim in June 2026 for R$ 42.000. Thinking of swapping the Toro for an electric car in 2027.
My passport expires on 12 January 2027. My driver's licence (CNH) already expired on 3 September 2026 — I have the renewal appointment at Detran on 22/10/2026 at 9am.
In April 2026 Gustavo paid back the full R$ 15.000 I lent him in February 2025 when his car broke down. I, on the other hand, still owe Juliana R$ 3.000 for my part of the consultoria's launch costs.
Bia's festa de 15 anos was on 05/07/2025 at Salão Primavera and it was perfect. Budget was R$ 25.000. I paid Buffet Sabor & Arte R$ 12.000 and DJ Léo R$ 2.500, and Ricardo chipped in R$ 10.000.
Back from Salvador! The four of us were there from 2 to 9 January 2026.
Booked flights to Lisbon to visit Rafael and Inês, 10 to 24 December 2026. Do I need to renew my passport before going?

seeds.text: Sunday night thoughts. Someday I want to open a small pousada in Tiradentes, maybe once the kids are grown. I'd love for Bia to do an exchange year in Portugal too. More concretely: I plan to start an MBA at Fundação Dom Cabral in March 2027, and to pay Juliana back the R$ 3.000 before Christmas.

seeds: Juliana and I decided to hire a junior analyst for the consultoria from January 2027. And Fernando and I decided Davi stays at Colégio Santo Agostinho for high school.
Davi has the orthodontist, Dr. Paula Menezes, on 28/10/2026. The IPTU on the Lagoa Santa lot was due 30/09/2026 — paid R$ 1.840 to the Prefeitura de Lagoa Santa on 25/09/2026.
Fun fact: Fábio Lima, Edson's cousin, donated a kidney to Gustavo back in 2018 — that's how we found Edson in the first place. Also, Vó Zilda, Mum's mother, died on 21/06/2015; I still miss her.
Until the house is ready we're renting a flat in Santa Tereza from Renata Moreira, Seu Joaquim's daughter — since March 2021, R$ 3.200 a month.
Correction: I left Banco Horizonte in March 2022, not 2021. I stayed on until the merger closed.
